_safety: start_delay_seconds: the module waits this long after boot before touching the display. If a USB stick holds Update\<update_file> (checked at start and every 2 s for the first 3 minutes, as sticks mount late), the module stops: its layers off, so a firmware update runs exactly as stock.
_comment: Climabar layout. Coordinates are inside the strip (0,0 = its top-left corner). Sizes: tools/fetch_icons.py (ICON_SCALE, DIGIT_H, PANEL_SCALE; make icons). After a change run: make
_center: the middle of the strip shows the fan speed or the airflow: whichever was just changed; when the strip pops up because of something else it shows center_default (fan | airflow)
_slide_ms: slide in from the bottom / out when hiding, in milliseconds (0 = appear instantly)
_radio_name: radio screen, where the stock big frequency is (radio/build_radio.py hides it): the live RDS PS, or the frequency while there is none; font / size / place of the stock digits (Noto Sans 61 px, digit tops at screen y 253)
_preset_names: learned station names (RDS) on the preset buttons instead of the frequency; the firmware draws them (init.axf patch preset_names), saved in E:\\climabar_ps.bin
_belt: the seat-belt symbol is a control of the stock status bar (tools/add_belt_control.py, init.axf patch belt_binding): the module only tells the firmware whether a belt is unbuckled
_doors: car seen from above while a door / the boot is open (replaces the full-screen Vehicle information popup; needs the init.axf door_popup patch); x, y: top-left of the card on screen, scale: drawn this many times the art size
_bt_title: BT Music: song title (from the phone) in the title bar instead of "Title"; empty = text when the phone sends none
_bt_title_off: the BT Music title bar shows the firmware's own title; font / font_px here are still used by the now_playing card
_now_playing: card when the BT song changes (not on BT Music, not in Android Auto / CarPlay): generated cover + title + artist

home_widgets._: Home: a row of chips under the tiles with the trip computer's data from the CAN box (outside temperature, fuel, battery), shown once the car has sent vehicle data and hidden while the climate strip is up
